lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build complete. **Two storeys:** `piece:0,0,0;half-s` + `piece:0,0,1;half-s` fused with `piece:1,0,0;half-n` + `piece:1,0,1;half-n` (half-bases paired to make full footprint, 2 storeys high, locked with `jointBolt:0#0,0#0` and `jointBolt:1#0,0#0` — meshClash clear).

**Bins on top (level 1):** `bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-half-s-full` and `bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-n-full` covering both top cells.

**Drawer below (level 0):** `drawer:0#0,0#cut` on the north cut face of `piece:0,0,0;half-s` (configurator only offers one drawer per half-base cut face; second lower slot conflict suppressed — single drawer provided).

**All edges capped:** 9 caps placed on every exposed exterior edge on both levels:
`cap:0,0,0;*;270`, `cap:1,0,0;#;270`, `cap:1,0,0;*;30`, `cap:1,0,0;*;90`, `cap:0,0,1;#;90`, `cap:0,0,1;*;270`, `cap:1,0,1;#;270`, `cap:1,0,1;*;30`, `cap:1,0,1;*;90` — no open `UNFINISHED_EDGE` remaining, `check_build` ok, meshClash clear.
